_comment: Room template library (CT-04/05). Authored in the Room Editor (scenes/tools/room_editor.tscn) or generated by tools/gen_rooms.py, then curated by hand - this file is canonical. zone picks the generator pool; type is a descriptive tag; depth_min/max (blocks below the waterline) restrict where a room may spawn; width/height are interior cells; objects x / blocks x are offsets from the west edge on the standing row; blocks dy = cells above the standing row; mat uses WorldGrid.M.
